newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint closes easier against dollar in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Forint closes easier against dollar in quiet trade.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed weaker against the dollar on Monday after a very slow afternoon session in the inter-bank forex market, traders said.
"There was virtually no trade in the afternoon," said Adam Szilagyi of ABN-AMRO.
The forint finished at 160.10/15 against the U.S. unit compared with its opening of 159.80/160.00 and kept its 60 pips distance from the central bank's resistance level.
On the Budapest Commodity Exchange, Swiss fanc and yen futures were the main movers as they finished lower for four maturities.
German mark futures ended lower for three maturities and rose for one. The dollar closed higher for two maturities.
Total turnover of the currency futures section was 5.72 billion forints or 41,589 contracts, of which 19,580 were for Swiss francs.
